SS316.notes: Stainless Steel 316. High density, high conductivity, structural outer casing.

PEEK.notes: Polyether ether ketone. Excellent structural and acoustic properties. Moderate thermal insulation.

PTFE.notes: Polytetrafluoroethylene (Teflon). Good thermal insulation, heavier, poor acoustics.

Silicone.notes: High-Temp Silicone Potting. Good acoustic matching, mediocre thermal insulation.

Aerogel.notes: Silica Aerogel Composite. Extreme thermal insulation, extremely poor acoustic coupling.

Vacuum.notes: Approximated vacuum gap (effective conductivity accounting for radiation).

Titanium.notes: Titanium alloy. High strength-to-weight ratio, moderate thermal conductivity.

PCM_100C.notes: Generic Phase Change Material melting at 100C. High thermal mass buffer.
